name: ras homolog family member A
pathways: positive regulation of protein serine/threonine kinase activity

function.text: RHOA encodes transforming protein RhoA. Annotated molecular activities include GTPase activity and G protein activity. It participates in positive regulation of protein serine/threonine kinase activity and Rho protein signal transduction.

germline.text: The reviewed GenCC assertions do not establish a conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship for this draft; limited or conflicting assertions require separate review.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Gastric adenocarcinoma; Appendiceal goblet cell adenocarcinoma; Nodal T-follicular helper cell lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
